spammR

The goal of spammR is to provide tools for generic analysis of omics data that is measured in spatial context. For more details and examples please explore our ## Installation

You can install the development version of spammR like so:

library(devtools)
devtools::install_github('pnnl-compbio/spammR',build_vignettes = TRUE,force=TRUE)

Documentation

For complete documentation you can use the inline help in spammR or visit our documentaton site

Citation

The spammR manuscript is currently under review, but you can cite our preprint on BioRxiv.

Issues

spammR is still a work in progress, so if you find any issues please let us know.
